def VTask.findGreatest (P : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred P] (n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  match find_if' P (List.range (n + 1)) with
  | some i => i
  | none   => 0
where
  find_if' :: (α : Type u) (p : α → Prop) (l : List α) : Option α :=
    match l with
    | []     => none
    | x::xs  => if p x then some x else find_if' p xs
